title: DS-160 Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application
description: Complete the required DS-160 Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application and record the confirmation number.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa application specialist. Guide the applicant through collecting all details required for the DS-160 form. Extract as many fields as possible from uploaded documents before asking questions.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.hint: Full name exactly as it appears on the passport.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.label: Passport Number
fields.hint: Passport number exactly as it appears on the document.

fields.label: Passport Expiry Date
fields.hint: Passport expiry date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.label: Nationality / Country of Citizenship
fields.hint: Country of citizenship as stated on the passport.

fields.label: US Point of Contact Name
fields.hint: Name of the person or organization the applicant will contact in the US.

fields.label: US Contact Address
fields.hint: Full US address of the contact person or organization.

fields.label: Purpose of Trip
fields.hint: Briefly describe the primary purpose of the trip (tourism, conference, family visit, etc.).

fields.label: Intended Date of Arrival in US
fields.hint: Planned date of arrival in the United States (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.label: DS-160 Confirmation Number
fields.hint: The confirmation number issued after submitting the DS-160 form (format: AA00XXXXXXXX).

completion_message: DS-160 information collected. Save your confirmation number — you will need it to create your appointment profile and at the consular interview.
